title: Spicy Cucumber Salad
summary: The cucumber is salted and drained before it is dressed. Those 15 minutes of salting are what make it crisp.
intro:
A cucumber salad that sits in a pool of liquid is one where the salting step was skipped. Salting the cucumber ahead of time and letting the water drain keeps the dressing from thinning out and leaves the cucumber crisper.

After salting, do not rinse — just squeeze by hand. Rinsing washes out all the base seasoning.
steps: Scrub the cucumbers with coarse salt and rinse them. If the bumps bother you, scrape them off with the back of a knife.
Slice on the diagonal, 0.4 cm (about 1/8 in) thick.
Sprinkle over 1 tsp (5 mL) salt, toss, and leave for 15 minutes.
Once liquid has pooled, squeeze the cucumber lightly by hand. Do not rinse it.
Slice the onion thinly, soak it in cold water for 5 minutes and drain; cut the carrot into fine matchsticks as well.
In a bowl, mix the chilli flakes, vinegar, sugar, minced garlic and fish sauce together first to make the dressing.
Add the cucumber, onion and carrot and toss lightly by hand. Kneading hard draws out water.
Finish with the sesame oil and sesame seeds.
tips: It is more evenly seasoned after 20 minutes in the fridge than straight after mixing. Past a day it starts to weep.
With no fish sauce, use 1/3 tsp (about 1.5 mL) salt instead, though it will have less savoury depth.
Fine chilli flakes coat the cucumber in a more even colour.
